description: Kanton Zürich (canton dataset republished on the City of Zürich open data portal) publishes the flood retention basins of the canton, which limit the peak discharge in a flood to a harmless value for the areas downstream by storing the additional water behind them and releasing it slowly, with an overflow to the stream bed for extremely rare events, as CSV, DXF, geodatabase, GeoPackage, shapefile and WFS. Coverage: the Canton of Zürich, published on the City of Zürich portal; the portal record was last modified on 2026-09-29. Format and access: WFS, CSV, DXF, File geodatabase, GPKG, Shapefile, WMS, downloadable without registration from the City of Zürich open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: the files were not opened, so the number of basins, storage volumes and design return periods are unconfirmed; the portal text explains the function but lists no attributes in the description. Simulation uses: flood-defence asset layers for flood-risk and cascading-failure models, reservoir and retention operation studies, and adaptation planning. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
